description: M.W.M. Afham Vs. Director of the Department of Education of the Southern Province and Others M.W.M. Afham Vs. Director of the Department of Education of the Southern Province and Others View More before Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
parties: M.W.M. Afham Vs. Director of the Department of Education of the Southern Province and Others M.W.M. Afham Vs. Director of the Department of Education of the Southern Province and Others View More
judgement_by: Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Petitioner sought to challenge the letter of interdiction, preliminary investigation report, the proceedings of the inquiry, the final report containing the said decision, and the final disciplinary order on the grounds of ultra vires, irrationality, unreasonableness, unfairness, and violation of the rules of natural justice due to inter alia undue delay of proceedings and ex parte proceedings. Held – Respondents had violated the Establishment Code, and rules of natural justice. Writs issued.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
